categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Industrial Process Control and Electronic Communication. The Industrial Process Control segment involves sales of control instruments, automation monitoring systems, and system integration engineering services. The Electronic Communication segment focuses on distribution of communication materials, industrial tapes, insulation materials, power distribution materials, and electronic components including ICs and IoT modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as IIoT (Industrial Internet of Things), PLC (Programmable Logic Controllers), and smart instrumentation for process control. It integrates hardware and software solutions for automation and monitoring, and develops proprietary applications like control valve maintenance apps and battery feedback systems. The electronic communication segment emphasizes design-in solutions and system integration for components like AI chips, ADAS chips, and GaN power devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor manufacturers, petrochemical, natural gas, biotechnology, steel, paper, cement, and shipping industries. The company serves both domestic and international clients, including government and private enterprises requiring process control instruments and system integration. The electronic communication segment targets electronic product manufacturers and trade partners in telecom, cable TV, and industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with expanding presence in the United States and Japan for process control projects. It has multiple offices and repair facilities across Taiwan including Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. Overseas subsidiaries and investments are located in the British Virgin Islands, Samoa, China (Dalian, Suzhou, Shanghai), Japan, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream system integrator and distributor within the supply chain. It acts as an agent and reseller of international brands, provides engineering and maintenance services, and integrates components into complete automation solutions. It also operates repair and calibration facilities, positioning itself between upstream manufacturers and downstream industrial end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding competitive new product lines under industrial process control and electronic communication. The company focuses on IIoT, PLC, water treatment solutions, and smart instrumentation. It invests in overseas EPC projects, expands repair facilities, and enhances supply chain and inventory management. R&D efforts target control valve maintenance systems, communication solutions, battery management, and integration of new semiconductor technologies, with R&D spending around 1-2% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of electronic components and process control instruments, system integration engineering services, and maintenance contracts. The company recognizes sales revenue upon delivery or acceptance, and engineering income based on project completion percentage. It also earns from distribution and agency agreements, providing value-added technical support and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In process control, major competitors include Honeywell, ABB, Yokogawa, Endress+Hauser, and Rockwell. In electronic communication, competitors include large distributors like WPG Holdings, Avnet, and others. The company holds a leading position in Taiwan and parts of China, leveraging strong partnerships with Emerson and other international brands, and is recognized for its comprehensive system integration and service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.55 billion in 2022, with a 4.4% growth over the previous year. Net profit after tax was NT$890 million, up 4.7%, with earnings per share of NT$8.68. Total assets were about NT$9.9 billion, and equity stood at NT$6.08 billion. The company maintains stable profitability and a solid financial structure with moderate leverage and strong cash flow management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes professional technical expertise, comprehensive product lines, and integrated system solutions tailored to customer-specific process control needs. It differentiates through strong after-sales service, repair capabilities, and close collaboration with leading global brands. Its ability to provide one-stop shopping, customized IoT and smart solutions, and local support in key markets enhances customer value and competitive advantage.
